answer.reason: The verses tell of Eliakim's part in the Assyrian siege and of God's promise to call him to Shebna's place of government.

clauses.english: asked Rabshakeh to speak in the Syrian language, not the Jews' language, in the hearing of the people
clauses.quote: Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language

clauses.english: was sent to Isaiah the prophet in sackcloth by Hezekiah
clauses.quote: he sent Eliakim, which was over the household

clauses.english: was promised by the LORD the government and the key of the house of David
clauses.quote: the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder

doubts: The report of Rabshakeh's words to Hezekiah with rent clothes is left out as a minor detail beside the other clauses.
